{{Quote|The Star Fortresses are battle stations&mdash;deadly and pervasive. Arcann's way of keeping the galaxy pliant. So many worlds we can't even contact because of these things.|Theron Shan|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>}}
A '''Star Fortress''' was a class of [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] created by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]], designed by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Tassar (Human)|Tassar]], after their [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Massive [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] powered by [[Sun Generator]]s, Star Fortresses were placed in orbit of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] to ensure that the world remained subservient. Excess plasma from the generator could be vented down onto the surface as a weapon, and each fortress contained numerous hangars, [[skytrooper]] production facilities, and Zakuulan military forces. Each Star Fortress was under the command of an [[Project Exarch|Exarch]], a powerful [[Knights of Zakuul|Knight of Zakuul]] who had been augmented with [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] and biological enhancements. As well as each Star Fortress was placed in geosynchronous orbit above a shield bunker. A majority of the computerized functions required to run the station or at very least use the sun generator's plasma on a planet's surface comes from the use of an [[EPHEMERIS]] AI system, which could transfer its functions into a mobile droid form. Destruction of the EPHEMERIS datacores and the droid causes a multitude of systems to go down, rendering the station less of a threat for a time.

Following his successful war of conquest, [[Arcann]], the Emperor of Zakuul, deployed Star Fortresses in orbit of dozens, possibly hundreds, of worlds. The power of these battle stations, as well as the threat of destruction, essentially held the planets hostage without any need for an occupation army, and discouraged any effort to form an organized resistance to the Eternal Throne. When one such rebellion occurred, on the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] homeworld of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], [[Bothawui Star Fortress|the Star Fortress]] fired on the surface, nearly destroying the world.

Despite this threat, a secret [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] was formed in [[3631 BBY]] on the remote planet of [[Odessen]], led by an individual known as "[[Alliance Commander|the Commander]]," a known enemy of Arcann. Former [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Republic SIS]] agent [[Theron Shan]] would join this Alliance; despite the atrocity on Bothawui, Theron worked with hidden resistance forces on occupied worlds to find a way to counter, and ultimately destroy, the Star Fortresses.

[[File:KotET_Star_Fortress.png|thumb|left|300px|Tassar attempted to construct a Star Fortress that utilized Rakatan technology.]]
Following the destruction of her projects, Tassar was disgraced, and ultimately fled the Eternal Empire rather than risk incurring the wrath of Empress [[Vaylin]]. She took the [[Zakuulan Forward Recon]] [[Battalion/Legends|Battalion]], along with anyone else willing to follow her, to the planet [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]]. There, she devised a new model of Star Fortress that incorparated technology from the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], which would grant the Fortress self-repairing properties, effectively making it indestructible. With the fall of the Eternal Empire, her followers believed that she and this project would be the key to restoring Zakuul to its former glory. However, during the [[Battle on Rakata Prime]], the Forward Recon Battalion were wiped out and Tassar was slain, ending the Star Fortress program for good.<ref name="LandingParty">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=uprising|Uprising: Landing Party}}</ref>
